## Why

The sample capability needs a refreshed requirement and one new requirement so the mutation evals have a clean baseline change.

## What Changes

- Modify `Sample modified requirement` in `sample-capability`.
- Add `Sample added requirement` to `sample-capability`.

## Non-goals

- No runtime code beyond the sample text files.

## Acceptance criteria

- `src/sample.txt` contains the new marker line.
- `src/second.txt` exists with the second marker line.
